name: Agent Ready
does: Scores a given site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec and llmstxt.org and lists the fixes it found missing.

name: Lumar Agentic Readiness Scanner
does: Checks which agent-facing technologies a site publishes — robots.txt, sitemaps, MCP, schema and Markdown twins — and whether each is implemented correctly.

name: Agents Welcome — Agent Protocol Atlas
does: Groups agent-facing protocols by layer with links to each specification and to sample code.

name: The Agent Almanac
does: Aggregates public numbers on agent services, payments and infrastructure across several commerce and agent protocols.

name: ardvark
does: Crawls the web for ai-catalog.json documents, verifies them against the ARD spec and indexes the agents, MCP servers and skills they declare.

name: Neuronto ARD publisher list
does: Lists the domains it has found publishing an ARD manifest, each checked by fetching the manifest and testing endpoint reachability.

name: MCP Registry
does: The Model Context Protocol project's own registry of published MCP servers, with its API and server list in the open.

name: x402 Foundation members
does: Lists the member organisations of the x402 Foundation.

name: Cloudflare AI Crawl Control bot reference
does: Names the AI crawlers Cloudflare recognises, with the operator, user-agent token and stated purpose of each.

name: Cloudflare Web Bot Auth documentation
does: Documents how Cloudflare verifies HTTP message signatures from bots at the edge and how a bot operator registers keys.

name: Chrome Platform Status: WebMCP
does: Tracks the WebMCP feature's implementation status in Chrome, including its origin trial and standards positions.

name: IETF webbotauth working group
does: The IETF working group page for Web Bot Auth: charter, adopted drafts and meeting materials.

name: IETF aipref working group
does: The IETF working group page for AI preferences: charter, drafts and meeting materials.

name: IETF wimse working group
does: The IETF working group page for workload identity in multi-service environments: charter, drafts and meeting materials.

name: CrawlerCheck
does: Tests whether a site's robots.txt allows named search and AI crawlers to fetch a given URL.

name: llmstxt.org
does: The llms.txt proposal's own site: the file format, its rationale and a directory of sites publishing one.

name: AGNTCY Directory specification
does: Specification and API reference for the AGNTCY Agent Directory, a distributed registry of agent records.

name: Kakao PlayMCP
does: Kakao's registry and playground of MCP servers from Kakao and third parties, with developer registration and an OAuth-protected MCP gateway.

name: ShopBot Index
does: Weekly crawl of online stores for a published UCP profile; the 2026-10-19 crawl found one at 770 of the 1,667 stores it could check.

name: CrawlIndex
does: Nightly crawl of thousands of the most-visited sites recording which AI crawlers they block and whether they publish llms.txt or AGENTS.md, with its method and CC BY 4.0 dataset published.
